description: This PHP class defines a data model 'SupervisorReviewerModel' used in the HR performance module, specifically representing a supervisor reviewer entity with serialization and normalization capabilities. It utilizes traits and implements an interface to facilitate API data serialization.

classes.name: SupervisorReviewerModel
classes.description: A model class representing the supervisor reviewer, implementing normalization and serialization of reviewer data for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a Reviewer entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
